attack_patterns: presence of suspicious URLs with uncommon or unrelated domains
advance-fee scam narratives involving inheritance or abandoned funds
medication and health product spam with embedded URLs
fake corporate or banking identities with fraudulent contact details
insertion of unrelated or nonsensical text blocks
attack_sophistication_levels: low sophistication: generic phishing with simple URL links
medium sophistication: social engineering with text obfuscation and domain spoofing
high sophistication: spear phishing with personalized messages and advanced evasion
mitigation_strategies: URL reputation filtering and domain whitelisting
machine learning classification trained on multi-source datasets
heuristic and signature-based detection of scam narratives
continuous update of detection rules based on emerging phishing lures
detection_approaches: email content analysis using NLP and anomaly detection
pattern matching for phishing URL structures and scam keywords
heuristic analysis of email address formatting and embedded contact info
composite scoring combining subject, body, URL, and metadata indicators
monitoring domain registration dates and reputation for URLs
